# Paid Media Budget Allocation

`paid-media-budget-allocation` · v1.1.0 · Design · Paid Media & Budgeting
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/paid-media-budget-allocation/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How should we split our paid budget across channels to get the most customers under our CAC ceiling?

**Inputs:** Business model, monthly budget OR CAC target OR customer goal, LTV, and per-channel CPC / click-to-lead % / lead-to-customer % (or cost-per-lead for directories)

**Output:** A per-channel budget split with projected customers, blended CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback, and weekly/daily pacing

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill paid-media-budget-allocation`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/paid-media-budget-allocation/resources/allocation-engine.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/paid-media-budget-allocation/resources/allocation-engine.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Input it doesn't recognise runs on the default channels rather than an error, and a missing budget or mistyped channel key gives a runaway or NaN allocation; check the result reflects your numbers.
- Any channel you don't supply in full uses AAJ's illustrative CPC, conversion and close rates, which are not benchmarks. Default channels you leave out stay in the plan on those placeholders.
- It reports paid-media CAC only. Fully-loaded CAC is higher, so LTV:CAC and payback here show ad efficiency, not the whole business case.
- The diminishing-returns curve and each channel's scale cap are modelled, not measured from your account, and it can't see attribution lag on deals that close weeks after the click.

**Review before acting:** Whoever runs paid media replaces every placeholder channel with account data, and the founder or finance lead confirms the LTV and budget, before the split sets spend. Rebalance monthly and track ROAS to 90 days.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/paid-media-budget-allocation](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/paid-media-budget-allocation)
